SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Properties of Matter? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of Matter.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Properties of Matter.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Properties of Matter.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Properties of Matter.

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

5. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

6. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Paper burning to ash

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

9. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Light? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Light.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Light.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Light.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Light.

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

12. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Heat? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Heat.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Heat.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Heat.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Heat.

14. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. watt (W)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Water Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Light and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Properties of Matter and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Water Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Light and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Properties of Matter and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Water Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Light and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

4. C — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

5. D — 100 °C

8. B — Producers

9. A — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

10. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Light.

12. A — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

13. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Heat.

14. B — newton (N)
